spec.text: Cinematic live-action film still, anamorphic lens, 35mm film grain. A weathered treasure hunter in her 30s, sun-worn linen shirt, leather satchel, short dark hair, steps from a wooden rowboat onto a wild volcanic island shore at golden hour and glances back over her shoulder toward the camera. In her hand an antique brass magnetic compass. Storm clouds breaking behind her, wet black sand, sea spray. Shallow depth of field, moody teal-and-amber grade. No text.
